title: keckia antirrhinoides
intro: Keckia antirrhinoides, commonly known as Keckiella, is a genus of flowering plants in the family Plantaginaceae. This plant is native to the southwestern United States and Mexico. Keckia antirrhinoides has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of Keckia antirrhinoides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
